scientific_findings: ADAPTIVE_FALSE_ALARM_SUPPRESSION: Conditioned threshold offsets (+0.06 on stops) successfully suppressed false omission alarms in unreleased plosive closures, lowering FWR to 1.65 - 1.72.

AP_INVARIANCE: Because AUPRC integrates across all possible thresholds, slot-level threshold shifts optimize the operating point precision/recall balance without altering the underlying probability geometry.
